Chauffeured wedding vehicles are priced by the hour on a published minimum; seats, rate tables, and deep FAQs live on the wedding transportation Scottsdale service page. Coordinate hotel pickups, wedding-party movement, guest shuttles, photo stops, and the final departure from one clear transportation schedule.

  • Bridal party shuttle. Hotel or getting-ready address to venue, with loading points the property allows.
  • Ceremony to reception transfer. Timed movement so the wedding party is not improvising the ride.
  • Grand exit vehicle. When included in the written confirmation for that booking.

Itinerary

Example itinerary. Your confirmed schedule sets the stops and times.

  1. Bridal party pickup (hotel to venue)
  2. Separate vehicle request for another passenger group
  3. Ceremony arrival at the approved loading point
  4. Confirmed photo-location transfer
  5. Ceremony-to-reception movement
  6. Guest shuttle movements if requested and confirmed
  7. Final departure vehicle if included in writing

What this experience covers

Two jobs often share one reservation family: couple and wedding-party car(s), plus optional guest shuttles between hotel and venue. Common movements include bridal-party pickup, ceremony arrival, photo-location transfer, ceremony-to-reception transfer, guest hotel loops, and a final departure vehicle when included in writing. Every movement is confirmed in writing after availability is reviewed. Share date, venues, passenger groups, approximate timeline, and planner contact when you request a quote. This page does not paste free-hour math or rate tables — see the wedding service page and checkout.

Example itinerary

  1. Bridal party pickup (hotel to venue). Who rides, who holds the phone, and the approved loading point all belong in the plan.
  2. Separate vehicle request for another passenger group. Multi-vehicle weddings list each group's schedule.
  3. Ceremony arrival at the approved loading point. Exact curb is the venue's call — Scottsdale Sprinters cannot invent porte-cochere assignments.
  4. Confirmed photo-location transfer. Addresses and timing on the reservation.
  5. Ceremony-to-reception movement.
  6. Guest shuttle movements if requested and confirmed.
  7. Final departure vehicle if included in writing.

Multi-vehicle weddings

Request the passenger groups, pickup points, and schedule for each movement. Vehicle assignments, the operating contact, and timing are confirmed in writing after availability is reviewed. Large-coach access is the property's call — share venue names early so reservations can flag known constraints; your confirmation should reflect any size limits. Compare the wedding service page for the full wedding vehicle range. Multi-vehicle coordination cousins: corporate transportation.

Working with planners

Add the planner or day-of contact to the request. Scottsdale Sprinters reviews pickup points, routes, and timing with that contact, then confirms the accepted schedule in writing. Put ceremony start, photo locations, and reception load times in the written plan so the chauffeur is not improvising. On an hourly wedding charter the booked window is yours — waits and photo stops sit inside those hours when listed on the reservation. Point-to-point transfers are priced differently.

White Sprinter and vehicle notes

The Executive White Sprinter can be requested for a wedding. Availability, cabin details, and any presentation requirements are confirmed in writing for the exact vehicle. See executive / white Sprinter fleet and the wedding service page for the full wedding vehicle list.

Rehearsal dinner and night-before movements

Rehearsal dinner transportation is typically a separate booking or an added movement on a multi-day plan — do not assume rehearsal hours are bundled into the wedding-day minimum. Send both dates, venues, headcounts, and vehicle preferences for a written quote. Same rule for welcome parties and farewell brunches: list them explicitly.
